checks.do: Whether the import file has more than 50,000 entries, which fails the import.
The failed-entries file linked from the result message for the reason each entry failed.
Whether the entries were in an earlier import, in which case they are added as additional information to the existing entries of the same name.

what-it-is.statement: Application Segment Import lets an admin bulk import database files, or bulk import application information, for faster application segment configuration.

quotes: Application Segment Import allows you to bulk import database files for faster application segment configuration for new and existing users.
Private Access (ZPA) allows you to bulk import application information to ease the process of application segment configuration.

template-fields.statement: Download Sample CSV downloads a sample template to the admin's system, and the page says to open the template file and add information for the fields Application Name, Application FQDN/IP, Server IP, TCP Ports, UDP Ports, App Owner Contact, Application Importance, Hosting Location and Environment.

quotes: Click Download Sample CSV.
The sample template downloads to your system.
Open the template file and add information for the following fields:
Application Name
Application FQDN/IP
Server IP
TCP Ports
UDP Ports
App Owner Contact
Application Importance
Hosting Location
Environment

limit.statement: The limit of application segments that can be imported is 50,000; importing a file with more than 50,000 entries of application segment data fails. Depending on how many application segments are imported, the import time can increase.

quotes: The limit of application segments that can be imported is 50,000. If you attempt to import a file with more than 50,000 entries of application segment data, the import fails.
Depending on how many application segments you import, the import time can increase.

results.statement: After an import, a message confirms the number of successfully imported entries and the number of failed downloads. A link in the message downloads a new file containing the failed entries and the reasons for their import failure.

quotes: A message appears confirming the number of successfully imported entries, as well as the number of failed downloads.
You can click the link in the message to download a new file containing the failed entries and the reasons for their import failure.

reimport-adds.statement: If a file is imported with entries that were included in a previous import, the new entries are automatically added as additional information to the existing entries of the same name.

quotes: If you import a file with entries that were included in a previous import, the new entries are automatically added as additional information to the existing entries of the same name.

merge.statement: Merging imported application segments takes at least two application segments selected from the table, then a Defined Application Segment and a Port Type chosen from the drop-down menus before clicking Apply. The table can show All, Defined Application Segments, Undefined Application Segments, or Partially Selected Application Segments.

quotes: Select at least two or more application segments from the table.
Select an option from the Defined Application Segment and Port Type drop-down menus, and click Apply.
Select an option to show application segments (All, Defined Application Segments, Undefined Application Segments, or Partially Selected Application Segments).

csv-values.title: CSV value formats and what Application Importance and Environment do
csv-values.detail: The page names the template columns but gives no value formats, and does not say what the Application Importance and Environment columns affect. A name search over the API spec, SDKs and Terraform provider found nothing for the import.

merge-creates-defined.title: Whether merging imported application segments creates defined application segments
merge-creates-defined.detail: The merge page names the Defined Application Segment and Port Type selections but does not say whether merging creates a defined application segment from the imported entries.
